For a good scan
  • One piece, red side up, on a plain non-red surface.
  • Live scan follows the piece nearest the middle of the view and answers once it holds still. Turn or swap the piece and it looks again.
  • Hold the phone straight above it; the piece can be any way round.
  • Avoid glare from overhead lights.
  • A tray of 8 or more pieces, not touching, gives the most reliable answers: the app can then tell their true size. Tap a piece on your photo to see its spot.
  • On a “Possible match”, check the other candidates too; the right spot is almost always one of the first three.
